title: About AeroGraph
intro: AeroGraph is an open-source command-line tool for keeping project knowledge connected.

choices.title: Local to your project
choices.body: Knowledge lives in a SQLite database on your machine. No account, no server.

choices.title: Connections you control
choices.body: You and your agents link notes to code and work explicitly, so the reasoning stays inspectable.
choices.tradeoff: Links need upkeep. Nothing is inferred from your code.

choices.title: Context, not orchestration
choices.body: Context exports as Markdown, so it works with whichever agent you use.
choices.tradeoff: Your agent handles execution and review.

status: Interfaces may still change between releases.
